sources.title: Natural environment
sources.role: Planning practice guidance on biodiversity and natural environment
sources.facts: Guidance covers ecological networks, protected sites and species, biodiversity net gain and wider environmental benefits.
sources.guard: Guidance and mapped evidence do not replace surveys, licences, consultation or exact-site ecological assessment.

sources.title: Local nature recovery strategies
sources.facts: Preparing LNRS is a statutory requirement under the Environment Act 2021 and each strategy is locally led.
sources.guard: A strategy area or priority does not itself impose parcel consent, ownership or delivery status.

sources.title: Local nature recovery strategies
sources.facts: Mapped LNRS opportunity locations can affect biodiversity metric strategic significance but do not replace project assessment.
sources.guard: Mapped opportunity is not designation, compulsory action, permission or guaranteed metric outcome.

sources.title: Local nature recovery strategies: areas and responsible authorities
sources.role: LNRS area and responsible authority register
sources.facts: Lists strategy areas and responsible authorities and is updated as contact and administrative information changes.
sources.guard: Administrative responsibility is not land ownership, planning jurisdiction for every decision or strategy completion.

sources.title: Complying with the biodiversity duty
sources.facts: Public authorities must consider actions for biodiversity and report on policies and actions; planning authorities should consider LNRSs.
sources.guard: The duty is an organisational obligation, not a parcel designation or automatic refusal/approval rule.

sources.title: Protected species and development: advice for local planning authorities
sources.facts: Explains evidence, survey and licensing considerations for protected species in development decisions.
sources.guard: Species records or potential habitat do not prove presence, absence, licence availability or decision outcome.

sources.title: Developers: get environmental advice on your planning proposals
sources.facts: Natural England, EA and MMO can advise on environmental issues and opportunities before or during proposals.
sources.guard: Advice availability is not endorsement, consent, permit, completeness or guaranteed mitigation acceptance.

sources.title: Protected wild plants, fungi and lichens: advice for making planning decisions
sources.facts: Guidance covers protected and priority species evidence and points to records and licence considerations.
sources.guard: Database search or guidance does not establish survey sufficiency, current presence or licence outcome.
